summary: The compliance review of the product 'GoldNow: Digital Top-up on Existing Gold Loans' identified three key findings against the reviewed RBI rules. First, the product feature does not explicitly mention that the contact details of the nodal grievance redressal officers are prominently displayed on the DLA, as required by [DLD2025:11(ii)]. Second, while the KFS is shown in the customer's chosen language, it does not explicitly state that the contents of the KFS are explained to the borrower and an acknowledgment is obtained. Third, the cooling-off period of 3 days does not comply with the requirement that the cooling-off period shall be determined by the Board of the RE as per their loan policy, and must not be less than one day.
